text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... I actually beat Opera O-san. My heart is pounding, thump-thump, thump-thump...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a calamity!?
To eat Doto's dust
before the Sacred Shield!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this too is a stepping stone to the next battle!
For I have obtained a peerless blade!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~. It's the peerless sword-y thingy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Doto and Opera O are pretty good.
Have they finally caught up to the Golden Generation?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I really don't think that's it.
The race itself was a bit lukewarm, after all...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Within the margin of error."
That was the margin between the two.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "The fundamentals haven't changed. Opera O on top, Doto just beneath, deadlocked..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two... ain't gonna reach the generation above 'em.
Not the 'Strongest Generation' that's broken the game at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I think I ran a little better today...
Even if it wasn't amazing, still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san!
Did I pass with this...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... have I become a sparkling Umamusume worthy of being your partner? W-W-What do you think?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Doto!
You are my irreplaceable right hand!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before surpassing the previous generation at the Arima Kinen,
why don't we run in the Japan Cup next?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: We shall show our peerless bond to the entire world! Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, Opera O-san!
Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer,
Opera O called me her "right-hand gal"~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could've pushed a little harder, but... it's okay... Opera O, whom I look up to so much, acknowledged me after all. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The answer was—already known.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The answer was—clear to see. It had been all along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The true identity of the ceiling. It was—
Meisho Doto's "salvation."
The greatest reason she had managed to keep fighting this far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her "feelings" and "reservations"
toward TM Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There's only one person I can consult.
I decided to ask for Admire Vega's opinion."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Just as I expected... And this whole incident
made it crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto doesn't, in the truest sense,
have any real confidence.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because she's always judging everything by Opera O's standards.
Being useful to Opera O, catching up to her, earning her recognition...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She has left even the judgment of whether she shines
entirely in Opera O's hands...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And the negative impact of Doto not reaching
her full potential is affecting Opera O as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O had now become one of
the representative Umamusume of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why rivals are necessary for growth.
Normally, Doto should be the one doing that beside her. But..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might be true. Meisho Doto isn't
the only one who has hit a plateau.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I have a feeling that one day, Meisho Doto
will realize it herself and awaken.
choice_data_list: If only it would awaken like it did that autumn...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No way. —Probably.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Think back to last autumn.
What was it... that happened?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto didn't 'awaken on her own.'
She simply 'had no choice but to awaken.'

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Because an accident happened. Because I had to withdraw.
The reason why we had to change
came from the outside...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"She... can't change on her own.
Because she's too kind. She can't just suddenly
turn the person she admires into an enemy."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You should know that.
Both of us know it all too painfully well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It was just as they said. There's no way Meisho Doto would do something like that on her own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For her to become the person she wants to be...
To truly awaken what's inside her...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The catalyst... has to be provided by someone.
No matter how thankless of a role it might be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I have to talk to Meisho Doto.
Without fail, before our next race, the Japan Cup.
